The WHOLE text (not the first 60 / 80 lines) of 843 files (377 paths — a name such as slice.cc matches several paths, java/rocksjni included — and every header of their directories) was searched line by line for: copyright, (c) <year>, redistribution / permission / licence words, public domain, released to, copied / borrowed / adapted from / originally from / taken from / derived from, and URLs; it was a pattern search with a look at each hit, not a read of every line by a person. Not shipped, found in a mapped source, not compiled for these targets: util/crc32c.cc:399-428 (Ferry Toth) is the notice of crc32c_3way, which sits in util/crc32c.cc:429-1104 under #if defined(__SSE4_2__) && defined(__PCLMUL__); the x86_64 .so holds 0 pclmul instructions (llvm-objdump -d, 1,866,299 lines) and no crc32c_3way symbol, the arm64 and armeabi-v7a .so and the iOS arm64 crc32c.cc.o member use the HAVE_ARM64_CRC / table path (no 3way, no pclmul symbol), and the iOS x86_64 simulator slice holds the 5 lz4 / xxhash members only. Licence blocks found: PerconaFT (11 .cc and the lib/ headers), util/xxhash.cc and util/xxhash.h, BOTH blocks of util/xxph3.h (5-37 and 656-688), murmurhash.cc / .h, timer_queue.h (CC0), crc32c_arm64 (Arm), env_mirror.cc (Red Hat), memkind_kmem_allocator (Intel), crc32c_ppc*.h / ppc-opcode.h (IBM; no ppc symbol in the binaries); java/rocksjni/merge_operator.cc "Copyright (c) 2014, Vlad Balan" (the .so exports 0 Java_org_rocksdb symbols and holds no rocksjni string: the JNI sources are not in the binaries). Origin comments with no licence text in the file (facts): table/merging_iterator.cc:308 "optimization adapted from Pebble" (cockroachdb/pebble, LICENSE at master: "Copyright (c) 2011 The LevelDB-Go Authors", redistribution text, SHA-256 d1f46db68f5899a5…); util/string_util.cc:476 "Copied from folly/string.cpp"; util/crc32c.cc:1136 "crc32c combine, copied with permission from folly"; util/coding.h:71 "Borrowed from" fbthrift VarintUtils-inl.h (zigzag, 2 lines); util/slice.cc:243 "Originally from wdt/util/EncryptionUtils.cpp" (toHex); util/xxhash.h:3591 and util/xxph3.h:878 "Adapted from" google/highwayhash (util/xxhash.h:4291 is a quoted comment above XXH3_scrambleAcc_avx512; no highwayhash code follows it); util/thread_local.cc:229 a gperftools URL on the Windows-only #else branch (not built for Android, iOS); util/fastrange.h:7 a link to lemire/fastrange; util/hash.cc:150 "Adapted from XXH3_len_9to16_128b"; db/kv_checksum.h:80 a constant "taken from head -c8 /dev/urandom" (not a source); util/hash.cc:27 MurmurHash1 with a link to aappleby/smhasher (in the compiled rocksdb::Hash); util/mutexlock.h:157 "Inspired by Guava"; util/distributed_mutex.h:12 and port/jemalloc_helper.h:94 folly links. The rule: every hit in a compiled member that names an outside origin of code, or a licence or copyright block, is listed; links to papers, bug trackers, Q&A sites and design notes are not (review round 5); the doc holds the same list. Found, NOT compiled: util/work_queue.h (an excerpt from Facebook's zstd repo, its own Facebook BSD / GPLv2 block; only util/work_queue_test.cc includes it). The 127 headers that the mapped sources include from other directories (include/, the PerconaFT lib/ft and portability, port/) were read whole too (review round 4): only PerconaFT and include/rocksdb/utilities/env_mirror.h (Red Hat) besides links to RocksDB's own pages. Compiled-or-not test of the other origin comments: Pebble (merging_iterator.cc:308) COMPILED (comment on RocksDB's own code in a mapped member; 96 MergingIterator symbols); folly strerror_r trick (string_util.cc:476) COMPILED (non-Windows branch); folly crc32c combine (crc32c.cc:1136) COMPILED (Crc32cCombine exported by all 3 .so); fbthrift zigzag (coding.h:71) COMPILED (used by table/block_based/index_builder.cc); wdt toHex (slice.cc:243) COMPILED (slice.cc member); highwayhash (its code at xxhash.h:3591 and xxph3.h:878 sits under the PowerPC VSX / AltiVec guards) NOT COMPILED for these targets; gperftools (thread_local.cc:229) NOT COMPILED (inside #ifdef OS_WIN). No text of these origins ships. UNPROVEN — question for Damir: whether a text is wanted for the Pebble, folly, fbthrift, wdt, highwayhash, fastrange, smhasher and Guava fragments.
